description: For a returning customer: first call with phone and confirmed:true to request a code. Next call with the returned challenge_id and customer-supplied code. Saved details and recent service history are returned only after successful verification. If lookup fails, offer the new-customer form or office assistance. Never claim a match from the initial response.

challenge_id.description: The challenge_id returned by the first call; send it together with code on the second call.

code.description: The 6-digit verification code the customer received by SMS; send it together with challenge_id. Keep it separate from booking codes.

confirmed.description: True only after the customer agreed to receive a verification code at this number.

phone.description: Phone number on the customer account, any common US format; the verification code is texted to it.

name: customer_lookup

record_id.description: Saved office lead reference, when applicable.

request_id.description: Public operation receipt for support; never a provider customer ID.

title: Verify Returning Customer and Retrieve History
